versions.content: The DTC-specific Flash Red Stop Lamp shall be set to Un- available / Do Not Flash (0x03) in case the corresponding event has set Lamp On and the DemIndicatorBehaviour of the Indicator referenced by DemRedStopIndi- catorRef is set to DEM_INDICATOR_CONTINUOUS .

The DTC-specific Flash Red Stop Lamp shall be set to Un- available / Do Not Flash (0x03) in case the corresponding event has set Lamp On and the DemIndicatorBehaviour of the Indicator referenced by DemRedStopIndi- catorRef is set to DEM_INDICATOR_CONTINUOUS .

The DTC-specific Flash Red Stop Lamp shall be set to Un- available / Do Not Flash (0x03) in case the corresponding event has set Lamp On and the DemIndicatorBehaviour of the Indicator referenced by DemRedStopIndi- catorRef is set to DEM_INDICATOR_CONTINUOUS .
